sloka: कन्दरान्तरसंस्थानां पीडितानां महौजसाम् ।सिंहानां निनदो भीमो नभो भिन्दन् स शुश्रुवे ।। 5.56.28 ।।।।
transliteration: kandarāntarasaṁsthānāṁ pīḍitānāṁ mahaujasām ।siṁhānāṁ ninado bhīmo nabho bhindan sa śuśruve ।। 5.56.28 ।।।।

translations.english: The dreadful roar of strong lions, lying in mountaincaves was heard cracking the sky when they were crushed in the turmoil.
